source_version: Official SIGMA 14 (2018) article 038, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2018.038; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
changes: Standalone excerpt wrapper, attribution, selected task scope and editorial notices added.
Theorem and section positions restored at boundaries; displayed equations use internally consistent excerpt numbering.
Cited bibliography entries retained under original reference numbers.

The absent bbm, yfonts and aurical font families are replaced by portable installed DejaVu Math TeX Gyre double-struck c/d/1, fraktur a and script d glyphs; the distinct author symbol roles and all mathematical uses remain unchanged. The Greek upright font uses installed Euler. Optional illustrative tableau examples are excluded, so the unavailable genyoungtabtikz package is unnecessary.
